title: Random Lore Generator
body: A simple command line interface program to produce random excerpts of lore to add to the Lore Corpus.
motivation: It will help flesh out the Cogniverse. It could never have enough back story.

It willl use guidelines and existing examples of Canonical Lore, Registers, and naming conventions to ensure it sounds, looks and feels like legitimate Cogniverse material.
